items.headline: IBM issues surprise preliminary Q2 warning; stock plunges over 20% on weaker mainframe and AI-related demand
IBM second-quarter results miss Wall Street estimates as adjusted EPS and revenue come in below forecasts, triggering worst single-day drop in decades
IBM stock suffers largest one-day loss in its history after CEO warns quarter was 'worse than our expectations'
Analysts cut price targets and law firms launch investigations following IBM’s surprise profit warning and preliminary Q2 results
